archetypes.name: dyn-cache-accounting
archetypes.rationale: Cache-create fallback and per-step aggregation are the highest-risk math paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the cache-efficiency helpers in python/larch/report/tokens.py. Focus on effective cache-create handling for split versus legacy combined buckets, zero-read ranking, all-zero exclusion, and per-step aggregation across records. Check that ratios are corpus-level for steps rather than averages of per-run ratios. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
